summary: iter68 — Stats ticker feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases passing (public GET, admin GET, PUT persistence, enabled=false null-stats + re-enable, negative-boost clamp, no-auth public). Frontend: landing page (/) renders <StatsTicker> under Navigation with all 6 user-specified labels, height 37px (~h-9), auto-scrolling. Admin /admin > Ticker tab renders ticker-admin with all 18 per-stat testids (ticker-real-*, ticker-boost-*, ticker-total-* × 6 keys), ticker-enabled-switch, ticker-save-btn. Save action: edited trial_invites boost=7 → totals updated in UI and success toast 'Ticker updated — live within a minute' appeared → reset to 0. Per owner's request, no disposable users/reports were seeded (owner's 4 reports + 4 player profiles preserved). Final DB ticker state after tests: {enabled: true, boosts: all 0}. Real counts intact.
critical_code_review_comments: StatsTicker polls /stats/ticker every 60s via setInterval — acceptable for the low-traffic public endpoint, no auth required, cheap query.
Backend clamps negative boosts server-side (max(0, int(...))); frontend also clamps client-side — defence in depth OK.
Free-preview ticker render location correct: single insertion at ReportPage.jsx:2177 inside the (!unlocked && !report.demo) branch — premium view (later branches) does not include it. Good.

trial_invites and club_opportunities have no automatic count source (hardcoded 0 in _ticker_real_counts) — as specified by owner. Admin hint text in TickerAdmin.jsx correctly says 'Manual only (no automatic count)'.
seed_data_creation: None. Skipped disposable user/report seeding for free-preview page test per instruction that code-check is sufficient; StatsTicker render location in ReportPage.jsx:2177 was verified via grep/view. This keeps preview DB empty as owner requested.
